title: Silver Zoom Card: How to Claim Your Triple Cash Back Promo
summary: Explains how to claim and activate the Silver Zoom Card “triple cash back” promo, including eligibility claim dates (2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31). Covers steps in the account portal, confirmation, a 9-month promotional earning period from account opening with a 3x multiplier, and what happens if you miss the 2025-12-31 window.
